title: Phoenix Ring
wikitext: {{Infobox clothing |image = Phoenix Ring.png |source = [[Volcano Dungeon]] |value = 100 |gprice = Not Sold }} The '''Phoenix Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be found in [[Volcano Dungeon]] rare chests. If the player's [[health]] reaches 0 while wearing this ring, instead of passing out, the player will revive with half of their max health. This can only occur once per day. The exact amount of health the player revives with is Max Health * 0.5 + Number of Phoenix Rings equipped. ==Dyeing== Phoenix Ring can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==References== See Farmer::takeDamage in the game code ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Phönixring]] [[es:Anillo fénix]] [[fr:Anneau du phoenix]] [[it:Anello della fenice]] [[ja:フェニックスリング]] [[ko:불사조 반지]] [[hu:Főnix gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel da Fênix]] [[ru:Кольцо Феникса]] [[tr:Zümrüdüanka Yüzüğü]] [[zh:凤凰戒指]]
